_comment: SPLICE default hyperparameters. Override via CLI args or by passing --config.

_comments.delta: Confidence parameter for CASE gap-index bandit (CASE default: 0.05)
_comments.epsilon: Stopping tolerance: stop when tau <= epsilon (0.0 = exact top-k)
_comments.k_selected: Number of top demonstrations to select per task
_comments.max_rounds: Hard maximum number of bandit sampling rounds
_comments.n_demo_candidates: Number of demo candidates to pass to the bandit (arm pool size)
_comments.sigma: Assumed reward noise std for UCB confidence intervals
_comments.gap_threshold: Secondary gap-index threshold for early stopping

_comments.model_id: HuggingFace model ID for BPO rewriter (THUDM/BPO = LLaMA-2 7B fine-tuned)
_comments.load_in_4bit: 4-bit quantization for GPU memory efficiency (A100 compatible)
_comments.max_new_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate for rewritten skill prompt
_comments.temperature: Sampling temperature for BPO model (0.6 = stable optimization mode)
_comments.openai_model: OpenAI model name for API fallback
_comments.claude_model: Anthropic model name for Claude API fallback

_comments.n_rounds: Number of SPLICE iterative rounds (1 = single-pass, 3 = full iterative)
_comments.eval_model: BenchFlow agent for bench CLI evaluation

_comments.bench_timeout_sec: Timeout for bench eval create (SkillsBench task timeout is 900s)
_comments.max_retries: Number of API call retries on transient errors

_comments.max_tasks: Maximum tasks to include in demo bank (89 = all SkillsBench tasks)
_comments.max_chars_*: Truncation limits for demo fields to fit in context

_comments.n_tasks: Number of tasks for pilot experiment
_comments.max_bandit_rounds: Reduced rounds for pilot speed (<1 hour target)
